authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the DR-126 platform base/host-ABI TCB and loader-closure design contract: the allowlist taxonomy, the identity/version rule shape, the declared-vs-ambient split, retained loader-trace requirement, and the negative-test classes. It applies nothing, does not populate per-OS package tables, does not re-own DR-G07 extraction, does not re-decide D-006 numbers, and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/. The DR-126 row remains OPEN until coordinator disposition after independent review.
purpose: Give DR-126 a T2-02 candidate that locks the qualitative TCB shape D-006 left to this row, and reserves populated OS tables as G22 evidence.

tcbTextCarriedVerbatim.surroundingLaw: The full Exact-byte delivery section is L141-166. This row owns the last paragraph (TCB). Extraction/symlink/TOCTOU/spawn-binding remain DR-G07 / DR-103.
linesVerbatim: The signed closure also declares the platform base/host-ABI TCB. A closed
allowlist and identity/version rule covers every permitted OS ABI, loader, libc,
framework, certificate store, font, ICU, and comparable system-class dependency.
Loader traces are retained at qualification. Undeclared library/framework/tool
resolution, alternate loader search, or identity drift refuses; hostile clean
machines prove no ambient system dependency can enter silently.

governingSources.role: INHERITED v1-era pin. Named properties only: D-006 qualitative TCB is this row; numbers are G02; D-002 slice platforms. Live digest at reMeasurementAtV2.

identityRuleShape.declared: Every permitted member appears in the signed closure TCB inventory as { platformProfileKey, class, identityEvidence }.

identityEvidence.namespacesAndSelectors: Class-appropriate canonical name plus the selector the platform uses to name that object (not an unconstrained version-or-digest string).
identityEvidence.resolvedObjectOrPlatformAuthenticatedBui: Where the platform authenticates a build (codesign, package db, soname+ABI), that authenticated identity is the compared object. Unconstrained version strings are not sufficient.
identityEvidence.digestWhereBytesMustBeBound: When the member is a byte collection (cert store, font set, ICU data), bind a digest algorithm and a collection membership/root rule. The algorithm is named at population time; this contract requires that a named algorithm exist.
identityEvidence.architecture: Identity is architecture-specific. A same name on another architecture is a different member.

identityRuleShape.sameMeans: Two runtime objects are the same member iff platformProfileKey, class, and identityEvidence compare equal under the class-specific rule.
identityRuleShape.drift: Any runtime resolution whose identityEvidence is not an exact allowlist match.
identityRuleShape.populatedTables: Per-OS concrete members are RESERVED as G22 qualification evidence.

loaderTraces.rule: Loader traces are retained at qualification (DR-G22). Absence of a retained trace is a failed qualification, not a silent pass.
observationBoundary: initial process image and its declared TCB members
descendants and helper tools the core spawns
non-loader system-class accesses (cert/font/ICU-class) covered by the taxonomy
loaderTraces.evidenceJoin: Every observed event MUST match the signed active-profile table or fail. Partial traces are a failed qualification.

negativeTests.name: undeclared resolution
negativeTests.passProperty: An undeclared object on the active profile refuses. Cross-product: every slice-1 platformProfile × every taxonomy class that the harness can substitute.

negativeTests.name: alternate loader search
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object found only via an undeclared search route refuses.

negativeTests.name: identity drift
negativeTests.passProperty: A declared-name object whose identityEvidence drifted refuses.

negativeTests.name: hostile clean machine
negativeTests.passProperty: On a clean machine with ambient substitutes present, no undeclared system dependency enters. Failure is a refused start or refused load, not a silent use.

forTheIndependentReviewer: Attack any populated per-OS package list presented as decided.
Attack collapsing language-runtime TCB into core TCB.
Attack re-owning the whole exact-byte section.
Attack an allowlist with no platformProfile key.
Attack identity that is still name plus unconstrained version-or-digest.
Attack a missing declared-versus-ambient resolution predicate.
Attack traces that cannot prove full loader/system dependency closure.
Attack any silent v1-to-v2 path outside basedOn.method / honestyRepairsFromV1.

platformProfile.relationToEveryTcbEntry: Every TCB allowlist entry is keyed by exactly one platformProfile. An entry without a profile key is a failed successor.
platformProfile.memberPopulation: Per-OS concrete members remain RESERVED as G22 evidence. They MUST be independently frozen on the signed allowlist before G22 can QUALIFY. This artifact owns identity/resolution shape, not the populated rows.
platformProfile.prequalificationAuthorshipBoundary: This contract authors the profile key and identity/resolution predicate. It does not author populated members. A later G22 packet that populates members is a different artifact.

order: Select the active qualified platformProfile for this process.
Observe the actual object and the resolution route (loader path, search list, package db, spawn binding).
Allow only an exact allowlist match under the class-specific identity rule AND the declared origin/search policy for that entry.
Every other source or route is ambient/alternate and MUST refuse.
resolutionPredicate.declaredVersusAmbient: Declared = exact allowlist entry + declared origin/search policy. Ambient = any other object or route, including PATH, default loader search outside the declared policy, and install-time substitution.

tcbCarrier.owningRowForSignedClosureInventoryCarrie: DR-101 / DR-103 signed closure inventory. This artifact does not encode the table or the ceremony.
tcbCarrier.dependencyIfCarrierAbsent: G22 cannot QUALIFY until a signed allowlist carrier exists. Identity policy here remains reviewable without that carrier.
